description: COFACTOR-Residential Dataset 3 contains hourly imported-electricity and weather series for 194 Norwegian residential units recruited through Sikom Connect AS. The producer lists 154 cabins, 35 houses and five apartments, with one CSV per property and series lengths ranging from a few months to two years in 2021–2023. The DataCite record names a README and the project feature page and states Creative Commons BY 4.0. These volunteered properties provide demand shapes for cabin and dwelling simulations, but their owners do not form a national probability sample. Only the main ElImp electricity-import meter is described per building; heating fuel, on-site generation and end-use breakdowns are not established. Unequal windows, self-selection and seasonal cabin use are limitations when projecting countrywide demand. A reviewer-assessed use is testing peak and seasonal electricity assumptions for mixed housing stock. data-cofactor-residential-dataset-2-risvollan-trondheim is an existing related Trondheim apartment deposit with different metering and participants. No ZIP, CSV or participant survey was downloaded. The release page is freely accessible. The CC BY 4.0 licence permits free reuse with attribution.
